topic.label: Claude Apps on Third-Party Platforms
topic.desc: Claude Apps on Third-Party Platforms: Install and administer, Inference providers and models, Configuration, Connectors and extensions and Using Claude Desktop and operations.

concepts.label: Configuration
concepts.desc: Configuration: Configuration implementation, Configuration reference, Configuration changelog.

concepts.label: Connectors and extensions
concepts.desc: Connectors and extensions: MCP, plugins, skills, and hooks, Set up sign-in for managed MCP servers, Built-in connectors, Connect to Microsoft 365, Connect to GitHub, Connect to Google Cloud, Connect to Box, Connect to Salesforce, Web search and web fetch, Built-in browser and Claude in Chrome, Desktop and filesystem access.

concepts.label: Inference providers and models
concepts.desc: Inference providers and models: Models and effort levels, Deploy Claude Desktop on 3P with an LLM gateway, Deploy Claude Desktop on 3P with Amazon Bedrock, Deploy Claude Desktop on 3P with Amazon Bedrock Mantle, Deploy Claude Desktop on 3P with Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Deploy Claude Desktop on 3P with Microsoft Foundry, Deploy Claude Desktop on 3P with the Claude API.

concepts.label: Install and administer
concepts.desc: Install and administer: Overview, Features, Installation and setup, Deploy with Enterprise Admin Console, Deploy with MDM, Deploy with a bootstrap server, In-app configuration, Write a credential helper, Import history from claude.ai, Migrate Claude Desktop from a cloud provider to Claude Enterprise, Sign in through the OS identity broker.

concepts.label: Using Claude Desktop and operations
concepts.desc: Using Claude Desktop and operations: Unified Claude in Claude Desktop on 3P, Chat in Claude Desktop on 3P, Code in Claude Desktop on 3P, SSH remote sessions in Claude Desktop on 3P, Show a status line, Telemetry and egress, Network proxy, User identity and local data, Legal and compliance.

skills.label: Configuration changelog
skills.desc: Managed configuration keys by the Claude Desktop release they first shipped in

skills.label: Configuration implementation
skills.desc: Compare where Claude Desktop on 3P reads configuration in each kind of deployment, and write values for a profile, the registry, or the Linux file

skills.label: Configuration reference
skills.desc: Every managed-configuration key Claude Desktop on 3P supports, what it controls, and recommended security profiles

skills.label: Built-in browser and Claude in Chrome
skills.desc: Configuring Claude in Chrome and the built-in browser in Cowork and Code for Claude Desktop 3P

skills.label: Built-in connectors
skills.desc: MCP servers bundled inside Claude Desktop on 3P: which servers ship in the app, how built-in entries work, and where each one is documented

skills.label: Connect to Box
skills.desc: Give Claude access to your organization's Box content through Box's remote MCP server, with an OAuth client a Box admin creates and a client secret helper script on each device.

skills.label: Connect to GitHub
skills.desc: Give Claude access to your organization's GitHub repositories, issues, and pull requests, either through GitHub's hosted MCP server or a server built into the desktop app.

skills.label: Connect to Google Cloud
skills.desc: Give Claude access to BigQuery and Google's other remote MCP servers with an OAuth client from your own Google Cloud project, set up in the Enterprise Admin Console.

skills.label: Connect to Microsoft 365
skills.desc: Give Claude access to your organization's Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Teams data through a connector you register in your own Microsoft Entra tenant.

skills.label: Connect to Salesforce
skills.desc: Give Claude access to your Salesforce org through Salesforce's plugin and hosted MCP server, set up in the Enterprise Admin Console or your managed configuration with an OAuth client that a Salesforce admin creates.

skills.label: Desktop and filesystem access
skills.desc: How Claude Desktop on 3P reads and writes files on the user's machine, and how to constrain it

skills.label: MCP, plugins, skills, and hooks
skills.desc: Extend Claude Desktop on 3P with connectors, plugin marketplaces, organization plugins, skills, and hooks for administrators and end users

skills.label: Set up sign-in for managed MCP servers
skills.desc: Decide whether a managed MCP server needs an OAuth client that you register and whether it also needs that client's secret, fill in the OAuth fields, and read the sign-in error messages.

skills.label: Web search and web fetch
skills.desc: How Claude Desktop on 3P reaches the internet, which providers support search, and how to control or disable web access

skills.label: Deploy Claude Desktop on 3P with Amazon Bedrock
skills.desc: Set up AWS, choose an authentication path for your organization, and configure Claude Desktop on 3P to use Claude models on Amazon Bedrock

skills.label: Deploy Claude Desktop on 3P with Amazon Bedrock Mantle
skills.desc: Configure Claude Desktop on 3P to use Claude models through Amazon Bedrock Mantle's Anthropic-native API surface

skills.label: Deploy Claude Desktop on 3P with an LLM gateway
skills.desc: Configure Claude Desktop on 3P to use Claude models on a self-hosted gateway that implements the Anthropic Messages API

skills.label: Deploy Claude Desktop on 3P with Google Cloud's Agent Platform
skills.desc: Set up Google Cloud, choose an authentication path for your organization, and configure Claude Desktop on 3P to use Claude models on Google Cloud's Agent Platform

skills.label: Deploy Claude Desktop on 3P with Microsoft Foundry
skills.desc: Set up Microsoft Foundry, choose an authentication path for your organization, and configure Claude Desktop on 3P to use Claude models on Microsoft Foundry

skills.label: Deploy Claude Desktop on 3P with the Claude API
skills.desc: Configure Claude Desktop on 3P to send inference directly to Anthropic's Claude API instead of a cloud-provider-hosted Claude deployment

skills.desc: Which models Claude Desktop on 3P offers, the default model and its starting effort level, per-model effort caps, display names, and 1M-context variants

skills.label: Deploy with a bootstrap server
skills.desc: Host an HTTPS endpoint that returns each user's configuration, for organizations without MDM or with role-based configuration too complex for per-group profiles

skills.label: Deploy with Enterprise Admin Console
skills.desc: Manage your organization's Claude Desktop 3P configuration centrally with the Enterprise Admin Console, hosted by Anthropic

skills.label: Deploy with MDM
skills.desc: Author a full configuration in the app, export it as a profile, and deploy it fleet-wide with Jamf, Intune, Group Policy, or any MDM

skills.desc: Bring conversations, projects, and local Cowork and Code sessions into Claude Desktop on 3P from a claude.ai workspace, an earlier install, or another device

skills.label: In-app configuration
skills.desc: Build, test, and export a Claude Desktop on 3P configuration from inside the app, with validation and per-provider guidance

skills.desc: Install Claude Desktop on 3P, check device readiness, and choose whether configuration reaches your devices through the Enterprise Admin Console, an MDM profile, or a bootstrap server

skills.desc: Migrate Claude Desktop from a cloud provider such as Amazon Bedrock to Claude Enterprise and keep each user's local chats, sessions, projects, tasks, and skills

skills.desc: Use the operating system's native Microsoft Entra sign-in broker so Claude Desktop on 3P satisfies device-based Conditional Access policies

skills.desc: Supply Claude Desktop on 3P with a short-lived inference token by running an executable you provide

skills.label: Chat in Claude Desktop on 3P
skills.desc: What Chat can and cannot do in Claude Desktop on 3P, and how to configure it

skills.desc: How Claude Desktop on 3P configuration applies to the embedded Claude Code engine

skills.label: Legal and compliance
skills.desc: Legal agreements, compliance, and security information for Claude Desktop on 3P

skills.desc: Show a status line above the message box in Claude Desktop on 3P: one line of your organization's own text, such as budget used, from a program you install

skills.desc: What Claude Desktop on 3P sends to Anthropic, how to disable it, and the network paths your firewall needs to allow
